mechanism: Risedronate may cause esophageal irritation and GI upset, while tranylcypromine (MAOI) can cause orthostatic hypotension and CNS effects; combined use increases risk of syncope and GI complications.
action: Monitor for orthostatic hypotension, syncope, and severe GI symptoms; ensure risedronate is taken with adequate water in upright position; consider alternative antidepressant if possible.
